name: Picker dialog help
description: Help mode entries for the picker dialog plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Drop-down
entries.text: Shows what is chosen (and how many, for a multiple choice). Tap it, or press Enter, Space or the down arrow, to open the list as a picker.

entries.title: Search the list
entries.text: Type to narrow the list; it matches names, descriptions and group names. Appears when the list is long (Settings → Plugins → Picker dialog sets how long).

entries.title: A choice
entries.text: Tap to choose it. In a multiple choice each tap ticks or unticks it; Done closes the picker. Arrow keys move, Enter chooses, Escape closes without a change.

entries.title: Done
entries.text: Closes a multiple-choice picker and keeps what is ticked. Clear unticks everything.

entries.title: Open drop-downs in the picker dialog
entries.text: On: every drop-down opens the themed picker. Off: the browser's own drop-downs come back, untouched.

entries.title: Search box threshold
entries.text: The search box shows when a list has at least this many options. 0 = always.

entries.title: Bottom sheet on phones
entries.text: On a phone the picker slides up from the bottom. Off: phones get the centred dialog too.

entries.title: Framework select fields
entries.text: Framework select fields draw the picker field instead of a browser drop-down.

entries.title: Every other drop-down
entries.text: Plain select boxes get a picker in front of them; the original stays hidden and is still what the form sends.

entries.title: Keep the original drop-downs in
entries.text: Apps ticked here keep the browser's drop-downs.

entries.title: Picker dialog
entries.text: Settings for the picker every drop-down opens: switch it on or off, when the search box shows, the sheet on phones, what it replaces and which apps keep their original drop-downs.
